transitions.operation_detail: Cells and barcoded hydrogel templates are partitioned by vortexing, lysed by heat-activated chemical/proteinase lysis, poly(A) mRNA is captured on the bead poly(dT), and first-strand synthesis runs at 25 C 30 min / 42 C 90 min / 85 C 10 min. Emulsion breaking, de-partitioning and 1x/0.5x washing are folded in because neither sequence architecture nor strand structure changes.

Template switching: the untemplated 3' dC extension anneals to the TSO riboguanosines and the reverse transcriptase copies the TSO, appending its complement to the 3' end of first-strand cDNA. The RNA template is not carried forward.

Whole transcriptome amplification: 95 C 3 min; 11-16 cycles of 98 C 15 s / 69 C 4 min 20 s; 72 C 5 min. Bead removal by centrifuge filter and 0.8x SPRI purification, Qubit quantification and fragment analysis are folded in.

Enzymatic fragmentation with end repair and A-tailing (30 C 8 min, 65 C 30 min). Only the barcode-proximal fragment is modelled; middle and TSO-proximal fragments are produced but cannot be amplified by the sample index primers.
T/A adapter ligation with the diluted Library Adapter Mix at 20 C for 15 min, followed by 0.8x SPRI post-ligation cleanup.
Sample index PCR (98 C 45 s; 6-12 cycles of 98 C 15 s / 67 C 30 s / 69 C 45 s; 72 C 1 min) completes the P5/i5 and P7/i7 ends. Double-sided SPRI size selection and final QC are folded in.
